name: ProgressSteps
description: Mortar progress steps: where someone is in a multi-step flow, as numbered bars, circles with descriptions, compact bullets or one filled track (bar) for status such as an order's delivery, with the current step marked for assistive technology. navigation={false} drops the navigation landmark for status-only progress.

props.steps: ProgressStep[] ({ id: string; name: string; description?: string; href?: string; status: "complete" | "current" | "upcoming" })
props.label: string
props.navigation: boolean (default true; false renders a labelled group instead of a navigation landmark, e.g. for an order tracker)

contract.usage: Import { ProgressSteps } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
